address: Yıldız Mahallesi, Ortaköy Salhanesi Sokak No:5, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34349, Türkiye
bio: With stunning views over the Bosphorus, a roof that can be fully opened when the weather is fine, and a terrace that turns into a DJs' playground at weekends: Ruby is one of the hot spots in Ortaköy. The menu comprises dishes for sharing, traditional Turkish fare and a tempting range of pasta and risotto options. And whether you opt for the penne puttanesca or the grilled sea bass with spinach and orzo in a cream sauce, rest assured that your meal will be indulgent and brimming with rich flavours.
